This chapter teaches Haldia's chemicals/petrochemicals identity from WBIIDC, but the fetched park page does not name a refinery or fertiliser unit; not asserted.

WBCS 2022: the Haldi river is formed by the Kansabati (Kansai) and Keleghai and joins the Hooghly near Haldia. River-formation detail is not in the fetched industrial-park sources; not taught in this chapter.
